why: A September 2025 arXiv preprint (2509.03339), 'Line Graphs of Non-Word-Representable Graphs are Not Always Non-Word-Representable,' claims to answer this exact question in the negative with a counterexample based on Mycielski graphs of odd cycles.

found.title: Line Graphs of Non-Word-Representable Graphs are Not Always Non-Word-Representable
found.note: Preprint claiming to resolve the open question by exhibiting a non-word-representable graph (a Mycielski graph of an odd cycle) whose line graph is word-representable; not read.
